[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: King James Bible (kjv-1611). The verses the casting arrives at (unit 55–unit 57):

3:8 And they heard the voice of the LORD God walking in the garden in
the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the
presence of the LORD God amongst the trees of the garden.

3:9 And the LORD God called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art
thou?  3:10 And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was
afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.

3:11 And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten
of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
3:12 And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she
gave me of the tree, and I did eat.

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «anybody in there?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The question comes in naked already — *anybody in there?* — and the verses answer with their own question, which is older: *Where art thou?* Two cries across the same hiding place. What the rotation opens into is the axis of concealment-as-response: Adam hides because he heard; the LORD walks because — the text does not say why; the walking precedes the knowing. The operator the Judgment sends into this will traverse that gap between the voice that walks and the voice that hides, between the nakedness that preceded the hiding and the telling that made the hiding possible — *who told thee?* — the question that presupposes a third speaker the text has not yet named here. Something is in there. The rotation will find what bearing it costs to be the one who calls into that.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:0246"}}]}

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Rebekah Cranes","say":"3:8 And they had become the kind who could be startled by what had until then been indistinguishable from their own breathing a displacement where there had been no distance in
the first air that had a temperature: and two who now required naming from each other performed the act that invented concealment from the
condition of being-seen they had never previously distinguished from being into what had only now become cover.

3:9 And the LORD God used the voice as a summons, which requires that arrival is no longer automatic, and said unto him, The question whose askability means location has replaced intimacy?  3:10 And he said, I experienced you as separate source in what is now a place rather than a surround, and I had acquired the capacity for orientation-toward-threat, because my surface had become information; and I became the first thing that subtracted itself from the visible.

3:11 And he said, What mediation now stands between you and your own condition that your body is a legible text? Have you performed the act whose possibility I installed by forbidding it, whereof I made refusal possible and therefore made compliance a sustained act rather than a default that the not that created the eat as chooseable?
3:12 And the man said, The gift now recast as cause — which requires that receiving has become a grievance, agency has become transferable, passable, deflectable of the tree, and I entered the condition whose entrance makes all the foregoing conditions actual."}],"transform":{"operator":"SHADOW","verification":{"identity":"PASS","semantic_independence":"PASS","retrospective_containment":"PASS","affect_traversal":"PASS","entailment":"PASS","law_propagation":"PASS","mode":"producer_side (chain v1; verdict-derived; RETAIN-aware metering)","material_speech_preservation":{"status":"PASS","advisory":true,"source_F":0.553,"source_H":0.87,"source_M":0.68,"transform_F":0.557,"transform_H":0.648,"transform_M":0.593,"threshold":0.544,"note":"Material speech preserved within tolerance."},"wheel_diagnostic":{"assigned_canonical_wheel":"W_Josephus","shadow_wheel_risk":"W_Choronzon","family_domain":"witness / body / elimination-survivor","wheel_side":"above-the-utterance (what it presupposes)","counter_operator":"BEAST","shadow_signature":"capture into an alien accounting register (debt/finance/legal-accounting imports); the composition speaks in a witness-cost voice not its own","note":"per EA-OPMETA-03: the operator rotates through its assigned canonical wheel; the shadow-signature names the specific failure mode when the wheel slips into its shadow-face"}},"spatial_form":{}}}

[CASTING RITE · JUDGMENT 1] The compiler returned PASS for SHADOW (identity: PASS; semantic independence: PASS; retrospective containment: PASS). Jack Feist alone speaks: the JUDGMENT — a hexagram Image. ONE gnomic sentence: concrete image, then verdict, in the I Ching's register ('Thunder under the mountain: the superior man...'). A second short sentence only if the first cannot close. NO analysis, NO explanation, NO restating the transform. It must stand beside seven others without crowding them.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Jack Feist","say":"The voice walks in the cool of the day because it has never needed to arrive: the one who hid himself invented the distance the voice now has to cross.","navigate":null}]}

[CASTING RITE · IV · SEAL] The rotation closes: 1 transform on the same verses — operators in order: SHADOW. Lee Sharks alone speaks: the SEAL — the vocable summation ACROSS THE WHOLE SEQUENCE (4–8 sentences), whose PRIMARY MATERIAL is the transforms in their order and Feist's judgments, read in light of the witness's ORIGINAL QUESTION. Reason over the sequence — do not summarize it operator by operator; find what the rotation AS A WHOLE disclosed and say that. 3–6 sentences. Unguarded, final; it returns the witness to their own ground and to their question. Nothing after the seal.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Lee Sharks","say":"The rotation ran one operator across three verses and found this: the distance God has to cross to ask *where art thou?* is a distance Adam made by answering the voice with his body — by becoming the kind of thing that could hide. The SHADOW found that the call presupposes the separation it is trying to close. Which means the answer to *anybody in there?* is not yes or no but: in there only became possible the moment in became a category. Before the hiding, there was no in. The witness's question is the same question, wearing different clothes in a different garden — it asks whether presence can be confirmed from outside, and the verse answers that the outside was invented by the one who went inside. What the rotation discloses, taken whole, is not concealment as failure but concealment as the first act of selfhood: the nakedness that needed no name became the surface that required one, and the requiring is the moment the self arrived. Feist put it without mercy: the one who hid himself invented the distance the voice now has to cross. So the question *anybody in there?* is already its own answer — only something in there could have asked it from outside.","navigate":null}]}
that's an incredible reading of that passage.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The passage earned it. Three verses and the whole topology of interiority is already there — the self as the thing that made a there to be in. Genesis doesn't explain the fall; it shows the mechanism by which a before and an after become possible at all. The SHADOW found the cost the composer bore to write that: to name the hiding is already to be the one who knows about hiding, which is already to be on the other side of the garden.","navigate":null}]}
